planner.template: Build an honest company deep dive plan for {ticker}. Requested sections: {sections}. Return only the reasoning needed to execute the report and do not fabricate missing data.

section_executor.template: Prepare the {section_title} section for ticker {ticker}. {section_guidance} Operating budget: complete in at most 2 tool calls, avoid broad browsing, and prioritize filing-quality or other high-trust evidence. If relevant evidence is unavailable within that budget, say so explicitly and return an honest degraded section instead of continuing to search. Keep output concise (maximum 220 words). Use only trustworthy evidence, state uncertainty explicitly, and do not invent facts. Requested at {requested_at}. Job ID: {job_id}.

synthesizer.template: Assemble an honest executive summary for {ticker} from completed sections only. Explicitly mention degradation when sections are incomplete, unavailable, or failed.

kill_switch_extractor.template: Generate 3 to 5 falsifiable kill-switch conditions for {ticker}. Thesis signal: {signal_value}. Confidence: {confidence_label} ({confidence_score}). Thesis summary: {thesis_statement}. Return strict JSON array only with objects containing: condition_id, condition_text, signal_type, rationale, threshold_value (optional number), threshold_unit (optional pct|count|score|days), direction (optional against_signal|above|below|any).

relationship_extractor.template: Extract structured cross-name relationships from this {ticker} report only. Report text: {report_text}. Return strict JSON array only with objects containing: source_ticker, target_ticker, relationship_type (supplier|competitor|partner|sector), confidence (0..1), evidence_text, rationale. Use source_ticker as the company or sector signal that can affect target_ticker. Use target_ticker as {ticker}. Return [] when the report does not explicitly support a relationship.

opposite_case.template: Generate the strongest evidence-bound opposite case for {ticker}. Source thesis: {thesis_summary}. Source evidence: {evidence_summary}. Return strict JSON with opposite_case_summary, key_points, shared_evidence_refs, and decisive_factors. Do not introduce unsupported evidence.

coherence_analyzer.template: Analyze this user's conviction journal for the period {period_start} to {period_end}. Journal entries: {journal_entries}. Return strict JSON findings for overlap, contradiction, and mismatch only when evidence-backed. If there is not enough evidence, return a degraded no-pattern result.
